title: Robert Maxwell gatekeeping science via Pergamon Press

tellings.quote: And then you have Glenn Maxwell's father, Robert Maxwell, who's a triple agent, uh, MI6, KGB, Mossad, gatekeeping scientific discoveries through his control of journal publications via Pergaman Press.

plain: The British publisher Robert Maxwell, father of Ghislaine Maxwell, is said to have been a triple agent, working for MI6 (Britain's foreign intelligence service), the KGB (the Soviet security service) and Mossad (Israel's intelligence agency), and to have used Pergamon Press, his publisher of scientific journals, to decide which scientific discoveries got into print. The philosopher Jason Jorjani says this on the show without giving a source, and points to a piece he wrote about Ghislaine Maxwell on Substack, an online newsletter site. If true, it would mean one spy-linked man could quietly steer what science the world got to read.
